name: Tristan McHardie
story: A LINZ geospatial student or graduate profile records Tristan McHardie: GIS Administrator, Waikato Regional Council; University of Waikato thesis on internet mapping of demographic diversity.

His 2016 University of Waikato master's thesis evaluated web mapping applications used to visualise demographic diversity. It treated the way population information was represented and explored through web interfaces as a subject for GIS research. A separate LINZ graduate profile later named him as GIS Administrator at Waikato Regional Council; these sources describe specific periods, without assuming his current employment.
